انمحين (form VII)
# اِنْمَحَيْنَ (inmaḥayna) /in.ma.ħaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
# اِنْمَحِينَ (inmaḥīna) /in.ma.ħiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْمَحَى (inmaḥā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
